decisions.reason: Actual returned raw master compared against exact original on immutable alpha contact page. The yellow throat still forms a long straight tapered column down into the narrow human collar. Make the original neckline sit directly beneath the compact round head, with a VERY SHORT BROAD curved transition, adapting collar circumference and shoulder fit without changing the original uniform design. The original collar's small gold ornament arrangement was also simplified to three oversized isolated stars. Restore the exact visible small gold detail layout, relative scale and placement from image2; retain its actual material outline rather than guessing rank or inventing named symbols. Preserve all unrelated exact source hair, cap, clothes, pose, expression, lighting, crop and restored opaque backdrop.
